# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- In AdventureWorksTool, all entity classes in the Models folder, including database-view models, should derive from EntityBase. Exclude the DbContext and EntityBase itself.

## Blogger Article Guidelines
- Use an HTML fragment without an <html> wrapper.
- Apply minimal styling.
- Provide step-by-step implementation instructions.
- Include complete custom source code (omit scaffolded boilerplate and CSS).
- Redact secrets.
- Add an architecture-image placeholder.
- Conclude with a summary.
